visual_contract: Visual children only. Existing target IDs, positions, collision spheres, health, attack rules, warning geometry and authoritative victory remain unchanged. Decorative structure is matte and never carries weak-point highlights.

I2.name: 双泵守卫
I2.silhouette: two unequal pump barrels joined by a dark return manifold
I2.dormant: pump shutters folded down, rotors dark, manifold remains on its suspension

F2.name: 折翼守望者
F2.silhouette: asymmetric broken wing and complete wing around a narrow avian archive core
F2.dormant: wings fold inward with their original hinges; archive lens goes dark, no replacement illusion target

I3.name: 熔炉履带兽
I3.silhouette: existing physical chassis with two dark tread bands and a furnace vent crown
I3.dormant: tread bands stop, fan shutters slump, furnace throat is extinguished

F3.name: 鸣菌共生体
F3.silhouette: three unequal voice caps and a gilled command crown; nutrient roots remain distinct
F3.dormant: command gills close and droop while intact matte nutrient tendrils remain

I4.name: 棱镜防御阵列
I4.silhouette: two triangular prism sockets joined to a hexagonal optical distributor
I4.dormant: prism vanes tilt into their cages and the optical distributor is unlit

F4.name: 共脉中枢
F4.silhouette: braided industrial and living support with three visibly different return pods

weakpoints.core: shared seed and industrial retaining ring

F4.dormant: return shutters rest open but dark; the shared seed remains held by both lifelines, without choosing an ending

integration.decorate: Call once after arena targets and any I3 PhysicalCrawlerChassis have been created; Root may hide only returned original_meshes.
integration.apply_view: Call after the original arena.apply_view(state,open_parts,defeated). No self-processing or tween clock exists.
integration.victory: Only the supplied authoritative defeated boolean enables independent DormantRemains. core_hp=0 by itself does not display a saved victory.
integration.region_material: Shared eight-region finish pool for additive scenery; does not replace original ground/water shaders.
integration.make_region_badge: A compact editable eight-region identity plate for an existing sign or landmark face; not an automatic prop scatter.
